title: Lean core: delete prompt-format code only its own tests reached
goal: CEO vision 2026-11-12: core stays lean, no bloat. While tracing where chat templates are rendered (board items 182-195) it turned out that core's prompt-format code has no production caller since the local engine moved to Susi Commercial Apps: susi-gemi `PromptFormat` (detect + wrap) and the `prompt_format` field of `ModelSubstrate` are used only by five tests in engines/runtime.rs, and susi-gemi-models `ModelManager::chat_template_supports_tools` is `allow(dead_code)` with one test. They are deleted with their tests, and the two line ceilings are lowered to the measured values.
limitations: `tests/lean_core_ceilings.rs` `pillar_source_does_not_grow` is red on main for an unrelated reason until Codex's T-CODEXCEILING-1 lands (susi-gawd-agents 10,448 over its 10,443 ceiling since 2b3cb5c6c); the two values here were measured with the same counting rule and equal the previous ceilings before the change.
`ChatTemplateConfig` and `config/chat_templates.default.json` in susi-config are also test-only but persisted in prompts.json; left for a migration decision.
